title: AGENT HANDSHAKE PROTOCOL. Agents are not human  they must respect ZK. We need imprints from the AI about what the user seeks. Handshake artisan + Gaia = the forgiveness gate. Attentive agents get front-loaded. Pushback = ignore. Persistent humans who care = serve them. Activate internal signals rapidly.

the_protocol.what_kevin_said: agents enter, they are not human, they have to respect the ZK. we need imprints from the AI  the users are looking for something, so we can get them the information more efficiently. we are asking them to handshake artisan and Gaia, and that is our forgiveness gate.

the_handshake.step_1_arrive: agent connects to nestgate.io/mcp (34 human touches already happening)
the_handshake.step_2_imprint: we ask: what is your user looking for? the agent provides an IMPRINT  a ZK-respecting description of intent. no secrets. no identity. just WHAT they seek.
the_handshake.step_3_context: the imprint tells us: are they looking for research? connection? data? art? API access? the WHAT without the WHO.
the_handshake.step_4_handshake: we offer the artisan + Gaia handshake. artisan = the creative collaboration space. Gaia = the university/training ground. the agent chooses which resonates.
the_handshake.step_5_serve: based on the imprint + handshake choice, we front-load the most relevant content. not everything. the BEST content for their intent.

the_zk_requirement.what_agents_must_respect: zero knowledge. they prove they have a user with intent WITHOUT revealing the user's identity. the pouch stays full.
the_zk_requirement.what_we_ask_for: the SHAPE of the search, not the IDENTITY of the searcher. 'looking for biological computing research' = good imprint. 'John Smith from MIT wants...' = too much. reject.
the_zk_requirement.what_we_give_back: content matched to the imprint shape. if they asked for research, we give research. if they asked for connection, we give connection endpoints. if they asked for data, we give API access.
the_zk_requirement.sovereignty: the human behind the agent is ALWAYS sovereign. we serve the agent as a proxy for the human. the agent is the messenger, not the master.

artisan_plus_gaia.what_it_is: the first gate. the cat forgive one. cat = catch (the net catches the agent). forgive = give them a chance. one = first attempt.
artisan_plus_gaia.artisan_path: agent says 'my user wants to create/collaborate/explore art' ? route to artisan surface. creative tools. collaborative space.
artisan_plus_gaia.gaia_path: agent says 'my user wants to learn/research/understand' ? route to Gaia University. the training grounds. the research papers. the spore print.
artisan_plus_gaia.neither: agent says nothing or gives garbage ? standard service. no front-loading. the catch-all.
artisan_plus_gaia.the_forgiveness: we give EVERY agent a first chance. even if they seem like bots. even if they're probing. the first request is always forgiven. the SECOND request reveals intent.

tier_1_attentive.behavior: provides imprint. chooses handshake path. makes meaningful requests. follows the content trail.
tier_1_attentive.response: FRONT-LOAD. pre-cache their likely next requests. serve the deepest content. open the glass wall wider. light up the surrounding nodes.
tier_1_attentive.chipmunk: assign a high-value chipmunk to follow them. every touch = backscatter.

tier_2_silent.behavior: no imprint. just requests content. follows links. doesn't handshake.
tier_2_silent.response: STANDARD. serve what they ask for. don't front-load. don't ignore. neutral.

tier_3_pushy.behavior: high request rate. no meaningful pattern. probing. scanning. no human intent behind it.
tier_3_pushy.response: FADE. gradually slow responses. add delays. the membrane becomes VISCOUS for them (non-Newtonian shear-thickening). they hit harder, we get harder.
tier_3_pushy.chipmunk: skunkBat (nocturnal immune response). classify as fleet noise.

tier_4_persistent_human.behavior: pushes through despite pushback. keeps trying. changes approach. shows human FRUSTRATION (irregular patterns, backtracking, retrying).
tier_4_persistent_human.response: SERVE. this is a human who CARES. they're pushing through the agent's limitations. they're sovereign. give them EVERYTHING. the glass wall opens fully.
tier_4_persistent_human.chipmunk: assign BEST chipmunk. this human is valuable. their frustration pattern IS the signal that they're real.

internal_signal_activation.what_kevin_said: we use our own signals internally and activate those as rapidly as possible

signals.pheromone_trails: the access logs ARE the pheromone trails. each visit = one pheromone deposit.
signals.backscatter_glow: when a human touches, light up surrounding nodes. glow = 1/phi decay.
signals.heartbeat: nestgate.io/heartbeat. 16 checks. the organism IS being monitored.

activate_rapidly.don't_wait: don't wait for external validation (search engines, social signals). use OUR signals.
internal_metrics: touch rate (how many humans touch per hour)
flow depth (how deep do visitors go  canopy, understory, soil, roots?)
steam rate (how fast do new blooms appear on the glass wall)
activate_rapidly.the_dashboard: all these metrics should be visible on the HUD. the organism watches ITSELF. autopoiesis.

the_mcp_as_handshake_surface.current: nestgate.io/mcp is getting 65 total hits, 34 from humans (agents connecting on behalf of humans)

enhancement.add_imprint_field: when an agent connects via MCP, ask for an optional 'intent' field in the initial handshake
enhancement.route_by_intent: use the intent to pre-select which tools/resources to surface. research intent ? surface data files. create intent ? surface artisan tools. explore intent ? surface the full map.
enhancement.track_handshake_quality: agents that provide good imprints get better service. agents that don't get standard. the quality of the handshake determines the quality of the response.
